question: Independent training seeds gave five directional improvements in historical training-side replay. At the same number of base fits, do two complementary perturbations of training example importance add diversity without losing observations?
treatment: Preserve the selected base methods and their voting shares. For each previously repeatable member refit twice at exactly the two registered seeds, sharing the same row-group perturbations across members. Identical complete feature rows share a uniform signed value generated independently of labels. Center at row-weighted zero, scale maximum absolute change to .70; use 1+d and 1-d so each row has total weight 2, and each fit has the original total weight. The entire feature-engineering method is retrained normally, including its original cross-fitted feature construction. Only the final supervised objective accepts sample weights. No additional feature or method selection from the outer results.
primary_comparison: Same five historical 48-cap ordinary nominees, all 8117 course training rows scored once. Compare equal-weight original plus the two perturbed fits against equal-weight original plus the same two unperturbed seeds. Also report original alone. Seal all predictions before accessing any outer answers for this experiment. This is a fixed research comparison on reused development folds. Requiring >=.003 pooled, >=3 positive folds and worst fold >=-.003 against the identical-cost seed control justifies a prospective autonomous entry, never a course validation grade by itself. No language-model API, official test, designated validation or H2.
